customManagers.description: Argo CD apps whose chart repoURL is {{ .Values.base_registries.ghcr_io }}/...: Renovate strips the template, so the argocd manager looks up an empty registry (ignored above). Track these charts against upstream GHCR instead.

packageRules.description: Ignore platform-managed monitoring/logging Argo CD app manifests (chart versions are bumped via the platform release process, not Renovate). Scoped to this repo only.

Ignore container image updates in values.yaml ONLY for the images consumed by the apps above (kube-prometheus-stack/grafana, loki, fluent-operator, promtail, loki-alert-group-controller). Regex anchors are registry-agnostic because depName is registry-qualified (e.g. dockerhub.repo.gpkg.io/grafana/loki). All other values.yaml images still get PRs.
Helm only accepts a chart version in targetRevision, not a digest, so never pin digests for the regex-tracked charts above.
